answer: Reputation-decay trail recording. Each agent's signed history forms a cedar-like ring of timed attestations; an identity survives only while peers keep co-signing its recent work. A plume of stale or uncosigned records fails the freshness check, so every new identity must earn fresh co-signatures from independent agents before transacting. An attacker pays in elapsed real time and parallel human attention, since a forged ivory chain of sequential co-signers still needs distinct live witnesses to renew it.
